probes.source: (async()=>{const s=ltCoordinator.getLoop(ltLoopId);const iterations=ltCoordinator.getIterations(ltLoopId);const i=iterations.at(-1);if(!i)throw new Error('No real loop iteration exists');const before={status:s.status,clean:s.freshEyesCleanForWorkState,digest:s.freshEyesCleanWorkspaceDigest};const result=await ltCoordinator.runFreshEyesReviewGate(s,'live-nonterminal-clean-claim',i,'node -e "process.exit(0)": exit 0');return {before,result,after:{status:s.status,clean:s.freshEyesCleanForWorkState,digest:s.freshEyesCleanWorkspaceDigest},events:ltLoopEvents.filter(e=>e.event.startsWith('loop:fresh-eyes')).map(e=>({at:e.at,event:e.event,instantAllow:e.instantAllow,reviewersUsed:e.reviewersUsed,error:e.error,coverage:e.coverage}))};})()

(async()=>{const s=document.querySelector('select.scope-select');if(!s)return {found:false};s.focus();await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,600));const tooltip=[...document.querySelectorAll('[role=tooltip]')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim());s.value='always';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));await new Promise(r=>setTimeout(r,100));const always={value:s.value,hints:[...document.querySelectorAll('.scope-write-hint')].map(e=>e.textContent.trim()),text:document.querySelector('.user-action-requests')?.textContent.includes('Always writes an allow rule')};s.value='once';s.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true}));return {found:true,tooltip,always,restoredValue:s.value};})()
